title: Strict-local compatible-root tameness for internal modules
statement: Let $p$ be a positive prime, $Y$ a regular scheme [def-weil-regular-scheme], $D$ a reduced strict normal crossings boundary [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary], $w:W=Y\setminus D\hookrightarrow Y$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], $\Lambda$ a commutative condensed ring, and $L$ an internal $\Lambda_W$-module [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. At each geometric point $s:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa\to Y$ take $R=\mathcal O^{sh}_{Y,s}$ and its structural map [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. A boundary parameter tuple $(t_1,\ldots,t_r)$ is an initial part of a regular system of parameters [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters] whose product vanishes precisely on the inverse image of $D$. Put $N_p=\{n>0:(n,p)=1\}$ and form the actual $R$-algebra $R[x_{i,n}:1\le i\le r,n\in N_p]/(x_{i,n}^n-t_i,\ x_{i,m}^{m/n}-x_{i,n}\text{ for }n\mid m)$. Its spectrum, restricted by fiber product to $W$, is the compatible prime-to-$p$ root cover. Define $L$ to be strict-local Kummer tame when at every geometric point, for every such parameter tuple, its pullback to this cover is isomorphic to a finite direct sum of the regular pulled-back coefficient module. The pullback is the ordinary internal module pullback [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. The empty tuple gives the identity cover of the strict-local complement. There is no discreteness or finite-monodromy condition on $L$.
